name: comp-130
title: Dark Mode Toggle
blurb: Toggle button switching between light and dark mode icons.
description: Dark mode toggle using shadcn Toggle component with Sun and Moon icons. Icons animate in/out based on theme state. Fully self-contained with internal state management.
use_when: Adding theme toggle functionality to app headers or settings.
avoid_when: This manages internal state only—integrate with a global theme provider for actual theme switching.
a11y: Toggle has aria-label describing current mode. Icons are aria-hidden. Full keyboard support.
